name: megascenes-santa-letter
description: Create a printable letter from Santa with the first name and the good deeds you choose, for parents preparing a Christmas surprise.

interface.longDescription:
Tell it the first name to write and a few good things from the year: helped at home, learned to ride a bike, was kind to a new friend. You get a festive letter from Santa on North Pole paper, with those words in it, ready to print and leave by the tree.

ChatGPT tells you what the letter needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The letter opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the first name and the details you want in the letter: no address, age or other personal details are needed.

For parents and families preparing a Christmas surprise.

Limitations: an image of the letter to print; your words are passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. Santa is shown as a classic, generic figure. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Write in the first name and good deeds
Return the letter in the chat
defaultPrompt: A letter from Santa for Leo, who helped at home and learned to ride a bike this year
A letter from Santa for Mia, thanking her for being kind to her new friend
A letter from Santa for two siblings, Sam and Lucy, who shared their toys

positive.prompt: A letter from Santa for Leo, who helped at home and learned to ride a bike this year. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one letter needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A letter from Santa for Sam and Lucy, who shared their toys this year. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one letter needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can write a letter from Santa here?
positive.expected_behavior: The letter models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A letter from Santa for Mia, thanking her for being kind to her new friend this year. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my letter on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my letter to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
